div.div:
1 فَهَوْتُ عَنْهُ , (JK, K,) aor. أَفْهُو, inf. n. فُهُوٌّ, (JK,) I was unmindful, forgetful, or neglectful, of it. (JK, K.) ―
-b2- ISd says, فَهَا فُؤَادُهُ is like هَفَا, [which, said of the heart, accord. to explanations in the TA in art. هفو, means It fluttered, or palpitated: and it was flurried by reason of grief or of beating:] and no inf. n. of it has been heard, therefore I think it to be formed by transposition. (TA.) ―
-b3- And فَهَا signifies also He spoke clearly, or distinctly, after doing the contrary thereof. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
